title: Sean McVay: I didn't handle Jared Goff trade the right way, lacked courage to talk to him

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: I didn't handle Jared Goff trade the right way, lacked courage to talk to him
sources.description: "The handling of it was exactly the antithesis of how I would hope to handle things going forward," McVay said.
